tools.name: editor
tools.description: Revise a supplied draft with Editor, using Opus at low effort. It improves sentence and paragraph structure and removes AI writing patterns while preserving meaning. Supply the draft and a self-contained brief. Editor has no tools, file access, or conversation history. It returns the revised text, followed by any notes after a line containing `--- Editor notes ---`. The caller reads files and applies edits.
